models_evaluated: proprietary breast-specific ML model built on Open Triage platform

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of ML triage model versus specialist physicians on same cases
links.effect: ML model accuracy 100% vs physicians 83.9%; sensitivity 0.947 vs 0.826; PPV 0.500 vs 0.442; AUC 0.91 vs 0.83 for first prediction.
links.quote: The ML model demonstrated superior diagnostic accuracy (100%) compared to physicians (83.9%), with higher sensitivity (0.947 vs. 0.826) and PPV (0.500 vs. 0.442).

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative reader/vignette study comparing the diagnostic/triaging accuracy and turnaround time of a proprietary machine learning model versus specialist physicians on 174 breast cases.
